data.name: Hasnain
data.long_meaning: Hasnain is an Arabic name combining 'Hasan' and 'Husain', meaning 'two good ones' or 'two beauties'. It refers to the grandsons of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), symbolizing nobility and honor.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents purity, nobility, and the legacy of the Prophet's family.
data.numerology_meaning: Number 8 signifies power, ambition, and balance. Hasnain carries a legacy of strength and virtue.

in_arabic.name: حسنين
in_arabic.meaning: إسم حسنين يعني حسن الخلق و الجمال
in_arabic.long_meaning: حسنين هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه حسن الخلق و الجمال و يوحي بالصفات الحميدة و الأخلاق الرفيعة و هو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم و السنة النبوية و هو اسم شائع في العالم الإسلامي

in_urdu.name: حسنین
in_urdu.meaning: حسنین نام کا مطلب حسن خلق اور جمال ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: حسنین ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے اور اس کا مطلب حسن خلق اور جمال ہے یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے اور حسن خلق اور جمال کی علامت ہے

in_hindi.name: हसनैन
in_hindi.meaning: हसनैन नाम का अर्थ है अच्छा चरित्र और सौंदर्य
in_hindi.long_meaning: हसनैन एक पुरुष नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है और इसका अर्थ है अच्छा चरित्र और सौंदर्य यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है और अच्छे चरित्र और सौंदर्य का प्रतीक है

in_pashto.name: حسنين
in_pashto.meaning: حسنين نوم د ښه چلګر او ښکلا معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: حسنين يو مذکر نوم دی چې د عربي ژبې څخه راغلی او د ښه چلګر او ښکلا معنی لري دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو لپاره مهم دی او د ښه چلګر او ښکلا نښه ده

in_english.name: Hasnain
in_english.meaning: Hasnain means good character and beauty
in_english.long_meaning: Hasnain is a masculine name derived from Arabic roots, signifying good character and beauty. It is rooted in Islamic tradition, symbolizing noble qualities and moral excellence. The name reflects a person with a kind and attractive personality.

data.cultural_impact: Hasnain is a name deeply rooted in Islamic history and culture, representing the legacy of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his family. The name holds immense respect and reverence among the Muslim community due to its association with the grandsons of the Prophet, Hasan and Husain.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Hasnain holds a significant spiritual significance as it symbolizes the beauty and purity of faith. The name Hasan is synonymous with kindness and beauty, while Husain represents patience and perseverance in the face of adversity, as exemplified by the sacrifices made by these grandsons during their lives. The name serves as an inspiration for individuals to strive for good deeds, patience during hardships, and to maintain a beautiful and pure relationship with Allah.
